customer_name: State Grid Fujian Electric Power Co., Ltd. (国网福建电力)
business_problem: State Grid Fujian needed a province-level AI foundation that could standardize data collection, labeling, model development, deployment, and edge execution for power-grid inspection and operational use cases instead of leaving teams to work with isolated tooling.
solution_summary: State Grid Fujian and Baidu AI Cloud built a province-wide 'two libraries and one platform' architecture to support AI in grid inspection and operations. The sample library centralizes labeled data from different professional domains, the model library manages self-built, third-party, and open-source models, and the platform provides training and runtime environments for machine learning, deep learning, and edge deployment. Baidu's AI middle platform connects requirements, samples, models, applications, and iteration so Fujian can run a full lifecycle from data extraction and annotation through training, evaluation, deployment, and edge distribution. The architecture supports notebook, visual, automated, and pipeline modeling while also enabling cloud-edge coordination through OpenVINO-based deployment tooling. It is used in scenarios such as UAV line inspection, substation operations, customer service, and power-grid monitoring, giving Fujian a reusable AI operating layer rather than one-off models for each business unit.

solution_components.name: Baidu AI Middle Platform
solution_components.role: Connects requirements, samples, models, applications, and iteration into one governed AI delivery flow for the power utility.

solution_components.name: Sample Library
solution_components.role: Stores and manages labeled power-domain samples for shared use across professional teams.

solution_components.name: Model Library
solution_components.role: Centrally manages self-built, commercial, and open-source models for reuse across power-business applications.

solution_components.name: AI Training and Runtime Platform
solution_components.role: Provides notebook, visual, automated, and pipeline modeling environments for training, evaluation, and optimization.

solution_components.name: OpenVINO Edge Deployment Tooling
solution_components.role: Packages trained AI models for unified edge deployment and management on field devices.

data_flow: Operational and inspection data is drawn into the sample library, labeled and standardized, then used by the training platform to build and optimize models. Validated models are published into the model library and distributed through the AI middle platform and edge-deployment tooling to drones, substations, and other field or operational systems for live inference and alerting.
business_outcome: Fujian standardized AI delivery across power-grid scenarios, improved defect detection and operational response, reduced manual reading and field risk, and created a reusable provincial AI foundation that can be copied across the State Grid system.
metrics: AI inspection accuracy improved by 30 percentage points versus traditional methods.
More than 2,000 drones now use the platform for intelligent image screening.
Fujian has collected 500,000 samples and developed 108 AI models.
Average recognition across 16 transmission-defect scenarios reached 80%.
Substation switching efficiency improved 40x to 60x and energization time fell 80%.
